notes: Three routes, each with its own names, so no shared tail (rule 3): «قال سفيان وحدثنا محمد بن عمرو» and «قال وأظن أن ابن أبي لبيد» are second and third isnads for the same saying, each a group (rule 4).
The Sufyan head is kept for the later routes as in the worked example (rule 3 and example 3). The link «ابن أبي لبيد» is doubtful («أظن»): read as the text writes it (rule 9).
«خال ابن أبي نجيح» is an epithet of Sulayman al-Ahwal: left out.
